This means the actual item (not its key) gets added to the `seen` set, so `val` is never actually recorded, causing every item to be yielded regardless of its key collisions.

Fix: change `seen_add(item)` to `seen_add(val)` on line 266 so the key value itself is tracked in the `seen` set.
